sentences.en: While the autopsy questioned the day-old curious knife wound in his backside, it was assumed he'd stupidly sat on a very sharp object.

sentences.en: There is a big demand for day-old chicks during April.

sentences.en: Working with day-old hair will help add support and lift to this style.

sentences.en: It's easier to attach extensions into day-old hair rather than freshly washed hair.

sentences.en: Also keep in mind that day-old hair is much easier to work with than slippery, freshly washed hair.

sentences.en: In Wyoming's Grand Teton National Park a day-old pronghorn fawn snoozes away a June day in 2009.

sentences.en: BREADS, GRAINS AND PASTA: Look for day-old breads or visit a bread outlet.

sentences.en: A day-old brush turkey can run straight up a rock wall or a tree, an ability that diminishes as the bird gets older.
sentences.vi: Gà tây chải lông một ngày tuổi có thể chạy thẳng lên tường đá hoặc cây, khả năng này giảm dần khi chim lớn hơn.

sentences.en: The digestive system of 45 day-old abalone Haliotis discus hannai Ino is studied by histological method.
